title: Paul Keen & Fun Factory - Take Your Chance (2026)

lines.l: Take it, take it, take it, just don't fake it
Put me in spots and I'm gonna make it
Take a chance, come on, take that chance
Take your chance, bring your life up to the top
And you'll try to do it right
And life will always be around
Keep your feet down on the ground
And you will never be alone
